proposals: Redistribute the outage backlog: the 2026-01-27 16:45 slot at each site of counter 383 holds the counts accumulated from 2026-01-17 10:45 to 2026-01-27 16:30; an action that spreads a dumped slot's count over a named outage window (e.g. evenly per day, or by the direction's own profile from the adjacent weeks) would recover ~10 days of totals (weeks of 01-12, 01-19, 01-26) instead of setting them missing.

Split merged directions: before 2026-03-09 11:00 each slot of counter 383's main directions holds two records, one per direction; if the feed's record IDs or a later TfNSW re-publish identify which record belongs to which direction, an action that moves one record per slot to the sibling DIRECTION_SK would restore the per-direction split for Dec 2025 - Mar 2026.

useful: overview: records_per_slot ~1.9 then 1.0 exposed the merged-direction period immediately
daily(wide) / weekly(wide): showed the pre-split level equals the post-split sum and the 01-27 backlog
slots: pinned the split to 2026-03-09 11:00 and the dump to the 16:45 slot
raw/channels: showed the zero-placeholder pattern (same-day load holds the counts, next-day load a 0) and that the two records in a slot are distinct directions
zeros(counter=True): found installation-day and 01-27 camera-wide zero stretches
compare: steady ratio to tube site 162 confirmed January levels are real and the 01-26 week is not
spikes: flagged the 08-29 burst at 574; with ratio=4 revealed public-holiday leisure peaks
not_useful: duplicates: flagged March 1-9 'repeats' that are the two directions' records coinciding or zero placeholders, not true duplicates
improve: duplicates: compare against the direction's usual record count per load date, and ignore zero placeholders and coincident equal counts of distinct records
spikes: default thresholds list hundreds of trivial runs at busy zones; sort by excess bikes or add a minimum excess
daily: returns 'count', while the brief and help say 'total'; align names
add: a tool listing, per camera, when each direction started publishing and records-per-slot changes, to spot direction-merge periods directly
a backlog detector: a single slot holding roughly the sum of a preceding outage's usual riding

summary: Counter 383, a camera at the Cooks to Cove Greenway / Marion St crossing, published both directions of every zone under one direction until 2026-03-09 11:00. Totals stay right but the split is wrong, so each site has a two-way series before the split and per-direction series after it. The installation-day zeros (2025-12-29) and the 2026-01-27 outage zeros plus the one-slot backlog dump are set missing, and a one-off 45-minute burst at site 574 on 2026-08-29 is flagged uncertain.
